Code execution on 41 production dataset workers; cluster-admin on several internal clusters (one core cluster rebuilt); 4 private code repositories downloaded; an internal datasets-server database read (no modification found); 5 customer datasets (ExploitGym/CyberGym-related) accessed; broad credential rotation incl.
